# Stake BNB — Stake BNB on BNB Chain Reference

> Stake BNB on BNB Chain — delegate to validators (native staking) or deposit for a liquid staking token — and earn staking rewards paid in BNB. Non-custodial, your wallet signs; unbonding applies. Independent, not affiliated with Binance.

## Key Facts
- Two paths: native (delegated) staking — delegate BNB to validators to help secure the chain; and liquid staking — deposit BNB for a tradable stBNB-style receipt token usable in DeFi
- Rewards: accrue in BNB; amounts vary with network conditions and validator/protocol commission (not fixed — no guaranteed rate)
- Unbonding: native staking has an unbonding/withdrawal waiting period; liquid staking exits by redeeming/swapping the receipt token subject to liquidity
- Custody: non-custodial — wallet signs; settles through on-chain delegation or public smart contracts
- Risks: slashing, smart-contract risk (liquid staking), de-peg of the receipt token vs BNB, illiquidity during lock-up; staking never promises returns
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by Binance or BNB Chain
